title: POL-BAT-004 Battery Safety and Handling Policy
summary: Policy governing safety, handling, storage, quarantine, and transport rules for all lithium-cell components across Northbridge sites.
body:
POL-BAT-004 defines safety, storage, handling, quarantine, and transport rules for all lithium-cell components across Northbridge sites [^r4][^r5]. Approved by plant head [[user-hweber|Henrik Weber]], it establishes fire-cell limits, mandatory state of charge controls, and hazardous goods transport classifications [^r4][^r8][^r9][^r11]. Compliance is mandatory for all personnel working in battery storage and assembly zones [^r6][^r12].

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Document code | POL-BAT-004 |
| Version | v1.2 |
| Owner | Quality |
| Approver | [[user-hweber|Henrik Weber]] |
| Effective date | 2025-11-01 |
| Status | current |

## Clauses

### 1. Purpose and scope
The policy applies to all lithium-cell items at Northbridge, including [[items-bat|battery packs]], cells, hub and mid-drive motors, chargers, and any component flagged as a lithium cell in the item master [^r5]. In the Manchester plant, all covered parts must move directly to designated bunded battery cages [^r6]. At the Leeds site, items remain in the segregated storage area until required on sub-assembly benches [^r6].

### 2. Storage
Battery packs must be booked in Ledgerline to warehouse WH-MAN-STR within the Manchester main stores fire-cell area across bin zones BAT-Z1 to BAT-Z4, and must not use the legacy warehouse code WH-MAN-BAT [^r7]. Each fire cell has a strict limit of 1,500 battery packs, setting the total storage capacity of the Manchester fire-cell area to 6,000 packs [^r8][^r15]. Packs in stores must maintain a state of charge between 30% and 50% [^r9][^r16]. Charging packs inside the store boundary is strictly prohibited for stores personnel [^r9].

### 3. Damaged packs
Any battery pack that is damaged, swollen, wet, or dropped must be transferred immediately using heat-resistant gloves into the red quarantine bin containing vermiculite granules located in fire cell BAT-Z4 [^r10][^r17]. Staff must report the incident to Quality within the same shift by raising a non-conformance report on screen [[screen-qa-ncr-02|QA-NCR-02]] [^r10].

### 4. Transport
Battery packs dispatched alone must be declared as UN3480, whereas packs fitted to or packaged with a bicycle must be declared as UN3481 [^r11][^r18]. Every parcel containing a battery pack must display lithium battery handling label PKG-LBL-UN affixed flat [^r11][^r20]. Outbound shipments require carrier service DGX; missing labels trigger Ledgerline error [[err-dlv-0320|ERR-DLV-0320]], and unapproved freight carrier bookings fail with error ERR-FRT-0510 [^r2][^r3][^r18][^r20].

### 5. Training
All personnel handling battery packs must complete battery-handling training course BHT-01 before beginning their first shift in the fire-cell area [^r12]. Certification under BHT-01 must be renewed every 24 months [^r12][^r19].

## Versions and conflicts

* **Warehouse code booking**: Current policy requires battery stock to be booked in Ledgerline under warehouse WH-MAN-STR [^r7]. The legacy code WH-MAN-BAT was merged in 2019 and is superseded (`superseded`) [^r7].

r5.file: 01_policies/POL-BAT-004 Battery Safety and Handling Policy v1.2.pdf
r5.quote: This policy covers every lithium-cell part at Northbridge: battery packs, cells, hub and mid-drive motors, chargers and any item with the lithium-cell flag in the item master.

r6.file: 01_policies/POL-BAT-004 Battery Safety and Handling Policy v1.2.pdf
r6.quote: In the Manchester plant, all covered parts must move directly to the designated bunded battery cages. In the Leeds unit, items must remain in the segregated storage area until required on the sub-assembly benches.

r7.file: 01_policies/POL-BAT-004 Battery Safety and Handling Policy v1.2.pdf
r7.quote: Battery packs are stored in the fire-cell area inside Manchester main stores (bin zones BAT-Z1 to BAT-Z4). In Ledgerline they are booked to warehouse WH-MAN-STR. The old code WH-MAN-BAT was merged into WH-MAN-STR in 2019 and must not be used.

r8.file: 01_policies/POL-BAT-004 Battery Safety and Handling Policy v1.2.pdf
r8.quote: No more than 1,500 packs may be stored in one fire cell, so the Manchester fire-cell area holds at most 6,000 packs.

r9.file: 01_policies/POL-BAT-004 Battery Safety and Handling Policy v1.2.pdf
r9.quote: Packs are kept at a state of charge between 30% and 50% while in store. Stores staff must never charge a pack in the store.

r10.file: 01_policies/POL-BAT-004 Battery Safety and Handling Policy v1.2.pdf
r10.quote: A damaged, swollen, wet or dropped pack is moved at once to the red quarantine bin in fire cell BAT-Z4 and reported to Quality in the same shift with a non-conformance report on screen QA-NCR-02.

r11.file: 01_policies/POL-BAT-004 Battery Safety and Handling Policy v1.2.pdf
r11.quote: A pack shipped on its own is sent as UN3480 (lithium-ion batteries). A pack fitted to a bike, or packed with it, is sent as UN3481. Every parcel with a pack carries the lithium battery handling label (item PKG-LBL-UN).

r12.file: 01_policies/POL-BAT-004 Battery Safety and Handling Policy v1.2.pdf
r12.quote: Everyone who handles packs completes the battery-handling course BHT-01 before their first shift in the fire-cell area and again every 24 months.

r15.file: 02_procedures/SOP-INV-004 Battery Pack Storage and Handling v1.0.pdf
r15.quote: Put battery packs away only in fire cells BAT-Z1 to BAT-Z4. Check the cell's count board first: no more than 1,500 packs per cell (POL-BAT-004 §2.2).

r16.quote: Fire cells BAT-Z1 to BAT-Z4 in Manchester main stores No more than 1,500 packs per cell State of charge 30% to 50%

r17.quote: Red quarantine bin in BAT-Z4 NCR on QA-NCR-02 in the same shift Never put a dropped pack back on the shelf

r18.quote: UN3480 for a pack alone UN3481 for a pack in or with a bike Carrier service DGX

r20.quote: 1. Every parcel with a pack: label PKG-LBL-UN. 2. Pack alone: UN3480. Pack in or with a bike: UN3481. 3. Book carrier service DGX.
